rows.ARS:
Apricot or apricot blend Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Eclat de Haute Bretagne ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Michel Adam (France, before 2004).
Introduced in France by NIRP International / Lux Riviera in 2006 as 'Vedette'.
rows.Bloom: Apricot and pink, yellow undertones, deep yellow reverse. Strong, raspberry fragrance. up to 45 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered, spiral centers bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Compact. Large, glossy, dark green, dense foliage.

Height: 28" to 43" (70 to 110cm). Width: up to 16" (up to 40cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
